newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso halts slide as U.S. long bond recovers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso halts slide as U.S. long bond recovers.

text.p: The Mexican peso moderated its early slide against the dollar in mid-morning trade on Wednesday as U.S. long bond yields receded.
"Dealing has been slow in the market and the market is following (U.S.) long bond yields, which have eased off now," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood unchnaged at 7.8940/7.8980 and 7.7.8910/7.8940 per dollar, respectively.
Same-day peso contracts closed 1.2 centavos weaker at 7.8870/7.8900 per dollar.
The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond was meanwhile off 12/32 to yield 7.12 percent, after being off 14/32 in early trade.
